## The claim

Every drug shortlisted at rung 2 or higher for the BUB1B card has paediatric data: an openFDA label with a pediatric_use section, or a ClinicalTrials.gov study that admits children, in any indication.

**Prediction if true.** For each shortlisted drug, pediatric_trials.tsv holds at least one study with a child age group or the label check records pediatric_use=true.

**What would refute it.** Any shortlisted drug at rung 2 or higher with neither a pediatric_use label section nor a ClinicalTrials.gov study admitting children.
